Patient Rights

At KolkataElderCare, we respect and uphold the rights of every patient and their families.

1. Right to Information

  • Complete information about your care plan in a language you understand (Bengali, Hindi, or English)
  • Clear explanation of diagnosis, treatment options, and prognosis
  • Information about the qualifications of your care team
  • Transparent pricing with no hidden charges

2. Right to Dignity & Respect

  • Respectful treatment regardless of age, gender, religion, caste, or economic status
  • Cultural sensitivity in all interactions
  • Communication in your preferred language
  • Respect for personal space and modesty during home visits

3. Right to Consent

  • Informed consent before any treatment or procedure
  • Right to refuse treatment at any time
  • Right to a second opinion
  • Consent required before sharing information with family/NRI members

4. Right to Privacy & Confidentiality

  • All medical information kept strictly confidential
  • HIPAA-compliant data handling
  • Information shared only with authorized persons
  • Secure communication channels for all health data

5. Right to Quality Care

  • Care from qualified, MCI/NMC registered doctors
  • CMIG certified gerontologists for elder care
  • Evidence-based treatment protocols
  • Continuity of care with consistent care team

6. Right to Safety

  • Safe home environment assessment
  • Proper medication management to prevent adverse interactions
  • Emergency response protocols in place
  • Background-verified care staff

7. Right to Complain

  • File complaints without fear of retaliation
  • Receive acknowledgment within 24 hours
  • Resolution within 7 working days
  • Escalation to Grievance Officer if unsatisfied

8. Right to Choose

  • Choose or change your assigned doctor/gerontologist
  • Choose your preferred mode of consultation (video/phone/in-person)
  • Change or cancel your care plan at any time
  • Choose your preferred pharmacy for medicine delivery

9. Family/NRI Rights

  • Regular updates on your parent's health (as authorized)
  • Participate in care planning discussions
  • Access to all reports and prescriptions via WhatsApp
  • Book and manage appointments from anywhere in the world
